name: Leila Atbi
subject: the zayed students summer invite
hook_quote: level up your professional skills this summer!

beats.hook: You invited Zayed University students to level up their professional skills this summer. Not many would bother.
beats.identity: I spend my days finding who'd pay for your coaching. A life coach in Abu Dhabi closed AED 18k in 30 days from introductions I made.
beats.offer: I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.
beats.cta: Worth 15 minutes? You'll have the 10 within a day of us speaking, and I'll show you how I picked them.
beats.ps: ps: a straight no is a fine answer, and costs you nothing.
